fixes.why: a pointer crossing the row to reach 'Begin the conversation' opens every strip it passes, each a 350ms flex transition plus a ResizeObserver refresh

fixes.why: a 99KB sheet is fetched at page load (not lazy) to show two 220x250 crops; a cropped file is under 15KB
